title: AHEAD: Adaptive Hindsight with Environment-Augmented Distillation for Agentic RL
abstract: arXiv:2608.24114v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training multi-turn LLM agents with reinforcement learning typically relies on trajectory-level rewards, which assign a uniform advantage to every step and cannot identify which decisions led to success or failure. Self-distillation methods can provide finer-grained supervision by augmenting RL with privileged information. However, existing approaches usually apply the same type of privileged information to every step in an indistinguishable manner, ignoring a key asymmetry: routine steps need little additional guidance, while critical error steps require corrective direction that environment feedback alone cannot provide. We propose AHEAD, a step-aware framework that matches different supervision sources to different step types. The teacher receives environment feedback on all steps as a grounded dense signal, and additionally receives LLM-generated corrective hints on error steps to supply the direction that environment feedback lacks.

translated_title: AHEAD：通过环境增强蒸馏的自适应事后学习用于智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 使用强化学习训练多轮LLM智能体通常依赖于轨迹级奖励，这种奖励为每一步分配统一的优势值，无法识别哪些决策导致了成功或失败。自蒸馏方法可以通过向强化学习添加特权信息来提供更细粒度的监督。然而，现有方法通常以无法区分的方式将相同类型的特权信息应用于每一步，忽略了关键的不对称性：常规步骤几乎不需要额外指导，而关键错误步骤则需要环境反馈无法单独提供的纠正方向。我们提出了AHEAD，一个步骤感知框架，将不同的监督源匹配到不同的步骤类型。教师模型在所有步骤上接收环境反馈作为接地密集信号，并额外在错误步骤上接收LLM生成的纠正提示，以提供环境反馈所缺乏的方向。
tldr: 本文提出AHEAD框架，通过根据步骤类型（常规vs错误）匹配不同监督源（环境反馈vs LLM纠正提示），为多轮LLM智能体强化学习提供细粒度且自适应的训练信号。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AHEAD, a step-aware framework that matches different supervision sources (environment feedback vs. LLM corrective hints) to different step types (routine vs. error), enabling fine-grained and adaptive training signals for multi-turn LLM agent reinforcement learning.
